titre: Synthesis test n°2 — English (4th year primary, first year)

exercices.enonce:
Read and answer.

Hello! I am Lina. I have two eyes and one nose. I wear a red dress and white shoes. I love my family.

1) What is her name? .......... (1,5)
2) How many eyes does she have? .......... (1,5)
3) What colour is her dress? .......... (1,5)
4) What does she wear on her feet? .......... (1,5)

My body. Complete with: eyes — nose — mouth — hand.
1) I see with my .......... .
2) I smell with my .......... .
3) I eat with my .......... .
4) I write with my .......... .

Clothes and colours.
1) Circle the clothes words: (3 points)
dress — cat — shoes — apple — hat.
2) Complete: (2 points)
I wear a blue .......... . (write one clothes word)

About your family. Complete. (4 points)
I have .......... brother(s) and .......... sister(s).
I love my .......... .

Possessive words: my - your.
Complete with my or your.
1) Hello! What is .......... name? (I am asking you)
2) .......... name is Lina. (about myself)
3) I love .......... family. (about myself)
4) What is .......... favourite colour? (I am asking you)
